purpose: Independent learner-facing sense check for deliberate Urdu A2 Unit 1 lexical targets before canonical generation commit.
scope_note: This evidence validates only the listed intended senses for generation. It is not a full passage linguistic/pedagogical review and does not promote educator/publication readiness.

targets.note: Rekhta lists service/duty/function uses for خدمت; unit uses the ordinary service sense.
Rekhta lists contact/connection/ties for رابطہ; unit uses practical contact with an office.
Rekhta lists request/application/petition for درخواست; unit uses a service/repair request.
Rekhta lists details/descriptions/explanations for تفصیلات; unit uses identifying details of a location/problem.
Rekhta lists complaint for شکایت and شکایت کرنا as complain; unit uses a customer complaint.
Rekhta defines درست as correct/right/free from error; unit uses correct price/statement.
Rekhta includes district/province/domain/boundary senses for علاقہ; unit uses neighborhood/local area.

Rekhta documents طے کرنا / مسئلہ طے کرنا / طے شدہ for deciding, fixing, or settling; unit teaches the compound-verbal use in وقت/راستہ طے کرنا where context disambiguates 'fix/decide' from 'traverse'.

guardrails: Frequency rank is not treated as a CEFR claim.
